First, let's recall the following identity: 

$$
{cot}^{2}⁡\theta ={csc}^{2}⁡\theta -1
$$

Substituting the above identity into the given expression, and then factoring it as a difference of squares, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{cot}^{2}⁡\theta }{\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta -1} & =\frac{{csc}^{2}⁡\theta -1}{\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta -1} \\  & =\frac{(\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +1)(\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta -1)}{\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta -1} \\  & =\frac{(\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +1)\cancel{(\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta -1)}}{\cancel{\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta -1}} \\  & =\operatorname{csc}⁡\theta +1.\end{aligned}
$$
